methods.label: Choose the boys and the girl
methods.explanation: There are \(C(5,2)=10\) ways to select the boys and \(C(4,1)=4\) ways to select the girl. Multiplying gives 40.

review.mathematicalCheck: \(C(5,2)=10\) boy pairs can each be paired with any of four girls. Every eligible group determines exactly one boy pair and one girl, so multiplication gives \(10\cdot4=40\) without duplication.
